first_prompt:
Here's some critical work to move our project forward. It was written for multiple agents, but I'd like you to execute all of it.

The brief's primary objective is to close the gap between us and indu

commits.summary: Freeze Gradebook and MATH-238 claims on the checkpoint route (verification pending)
commits.body:
The read-only history inventory recovers all three before-property executions of example 105, retaining both artifact bindings and the distinction between historical refutations and eligible JVM evidence. Example 198 compares three Gradebook revisions on 306 inputs and finds 78 missing final-slot writes. Example 309 builds each complete upstream MathUtils class and finds 45 of 441 wrong GCDs before the repair and none afterward. The separate zero law passes on all 256 inputs of both revisions.

Public planning and artifact-bound JVM replays validated both packets. Jobs 20261119-214230-gradebook-frozen-claims-on-the-checkpoin and 20261119-214238-math-238-direct-method-checkpoint-compar run the unchanged ordinary translation and checker on the frozen claims before the recipe and observer changes.

commits.summary: Compare binary repository blobs as bytes in the tree lookup test
commits.body: The restart kit placed a ZIP under llm-dlc. The reference check tried to decode jj's concatenation of an entire directory as text. Check directory absence directly and compare both the ZIP and the README against raw jj file output. The failing regression passes on the real checkout.

commits.summary: Bind direct and adapter proof recipes to recoverable executions (verification pending)
commits.body:
Plan and bind checker arguments from the same typed recipe. Preserve the original claim keys and classpath order, share preparations across tasks, and qualify concrete int and int-array candidates against the frozen domain and observations in fresh JVMs. The paired checker now supports scalar indices beside array roots. Persist the receipt identity, stages, artifact bindings, invocation and raw candidate across interruption and idempotent completion. Handoff lists executions and eligible evidence separately with their qualifications.

The Gradebook return probe established agreement and execution 20261119T220012Z-d733295c retains a full-state candidate before independent qualification. The ThreeTenBP hours adapter matched all direct JVM calls in each 36,864-pair grid. A wrong-unit build differed on 36,672 pairs in both revisions. The parent had 6,912 clock errors and the fix had none. Validated examples 198, 309 and 310, their route, workflow and qualification tests, and compiled and tested the Rust observer.

Jobs 20261119-220147-gradebook-qualified-attempts-and-interru, 20261119-215949-math-238-direct-recipe-on-frozen-power-a and 20261119-215957-threetenbp-hours-adapter-on-the-qualifie exercise the actual proof routes and fresh-checkout retries.

commits.summary: Qualify independent framework observations and version checker evidence (verification pending)
commits.body:
The framework effects checker can prove a return or an ordered send trace independently while preserving the complete original trace for JVM replay. Both shop revisions return 90 cents for quantities 99 and 100. Only the revised 100-item handler omits the send. A separate four-heap adapter and predecessor, setting and exception controls expose the exact domains checked. The shared Python decoder accepts historical untagged evidence and the versioned Rust output. Per-execution checker deadlines, CPU time and peak RSS make a repeated GCD obligation measurable.

Validated examples 193 and 197, the shop, four-heap and initialization JVM controls, the Rust library, decoder and route tests. Fixed the pipeline test checkout to include its new decoder and refreshed the binary tree lookup test’s cost row. Jobs 20261119-221145-qualify-heap-merges-initialized-display, 20261119-221152-qualify-integrated-jbmc-on-the-distinct, 20261119-221200-separate-quote-amount-and-ordered-send-r and 20261119-221555-retain-a-measured-gcd-checker-timeout-an record the checker runs.

commits.summary: Apply the adapter recipe to Commons Lang UTF-16 search (verification pending)
commits.body:
A second adapter instance maps two integers to a real StringBuilder and a code point, then calls the pinned public lastIndexOf overload. The independent token oracle counts UTF-16 offsets. The old library missed 25 of 160 searches and the repair missed none. Both passed all 85 absent-character and 120 single-unit controls, and the direct JVM calls matched the adapter throughout. Validated the packet, ordinary replay and six public task plans.

Job 20261119-222214-check-the-supplementary-character-search runs the five separate symbolic obligations with their prepared artifacts and correspondence evidence.

commits.summary: Separate compile stubs from the shop application artifacts (verification pending)
commits.body: The first independent framework checks were refused because their application directories contained the compile-time Kafka stub. Compile the stubs separately, give only application classes to framework discovery, and record both sets of hashes. The independent JVM still observes 90 cents for both orders on both revisions. Only the 100-item send disappears. Job 20261119-222610-recheck-quote-projections-with-compile-s retries the two original claims.

commits.summary: Reconcile concrete JVM evidence and freeze Gradebook frame rules (verification pending)
commits.body:
Check a replay's domain guard, program, selected values, input, JDK, class digest and ordered classpath against the prepared proof. Record both the checked adapter class and original class identities before launching a verifier. A retry refuses a different recorded artifact binding. Handoff groups historical executions by source and binding, can recover receipts retained by failed jobs, and counts required claim/subject pairs independently of retries.

Gradebook now declares the four absolute previous-value, full-state, interior and frame laws on every revision in addition to the five pairwise claims. A JVM snapshot independently checks old array-cell values on counterexamples. A machine-readable comparison reconciles all four original and revised Apache GCD statements with their artifacts, operational budgets and measurements. Validated all 20 Gradebook plans, the packet, decoder, qualification and history tests, and cost-tier lint. Job 20261119-223013-gradebook-independent-previous-value-pos runs the twelve absolute subjects.

commits.summary: Keep duplicate completions stable when a sibling claim is added
commits.body: A repeated delivery must match the original raw records and prepared binding even if target.json has since gained an unrelated task. Preserve the receipt's historical sidecar identity and reject conflicting content. The ordinary route now journals an unsupported translation before spending work on preparation. The route and recipe tests pass.

commits.summary: Expose claim-specific witness replay and keep late rejections in history
commits.body: A reviewer can submit typed concrete inputs through build.py --task T --replay-witness FILE. Each review binds the selected artifacts, rechecks adapter correspondence where applicable, runs the frozen domain and observation on the JVM, and journals its evidence. The last-slot Gradebook input reproduced the complete array difference, agreed on the return and was rejected outside the interior domain. The return-only proof remained eligible after its later replay rejection. Ran the three public reviews and the build, route and recipe tests.

commits.summary: VF-045: a second Codex session opened the run-brief skill before working alone
commits.body: The single-agent run foundation-and-python-restart, a new Codex session given a prompt that calls the work 'written for multiple agents', read .agents/skills/run-brief/SKILL.md in its first minute, then decided the brief was for one agent and worked on it directly, starting nothing. The finding records this second occurrence.

commits.summary: Codex sessions start without the Pets, Hotline, Safety Settings and Sites apps
commits.body: The ChatGPT account gives every Codex session its apps as deferred tools (codex_apps). On the user's word (2026-11-19), four that no work in this repository has a use for are turned off: Pets, Hotline, Safety Settings and Sites. GitHub, ChatGPT Space, Codex Document Control and Plugin Management stay. The loops pass the settings on every turn (CODEX_CONFIG in agent_client.py, as apps.<connector id>.enabled=false), and .codex/config.toml carries the same for a person's own Codex in a trusted checkout. Run 1 of foundation-domain-streams called none of the eight apps. Verified with codex debug prompt-input (CLI 0.170) rendered with CODEX_CONFIG: only the four kept apps' namespaces remain, and CLAUDE.md is still read; the TOML parses; the changed tests pass (8 of 8 files).

commits.summary: Integrate all restart verification results and publish the claim handoff
commits.body:
All 17 Gradebook and four Apache GCD claim/subject pairs are decided. The independent shop projections establish the returned amount and refute ordered-send preservation. Native covers the 71 two-root heaps and JBMC qualifies its separate four-heap overlap. Checker qualification preserved the branch and initializer differences and classified handled and escaping division. The exception-message, wide JBMC preservation and strict ThreeTenBP and Commons Lang gaps remain discoverable in their original records.

The handoff links the three Gradebook proof plans and late witness reviews, concurrent retries, both GCD strategies and a genuine one-second deadline, two independent adapter grids and the wrong-unit control. Receipt ingestion also reconciles a delivered result with the original journal's bound invocation and raw checker candidate. Verified this on actual old and new completions, validated all six example packets, and confirmed all twelve jobs are collected on this line. The merged-tree default suite follows this commit.

commits.summary: Execute BigInteger factory allocations from the selected JDK
commits.body:
ThreeTenBP initializes a nanoseconds constant with BigInteger.valueOf(long). The native checker now follows the actual factory, constructor and magnitude allocation bytes in the selected JDK image. A path that reads the JDK cache refuses that field. Missing images and unrelated methods retain their existing diagnostics.

The changed suite passed all four selections, including 58 Rust binaries. The new unit exercised fresh allocations and cache reads on JDKs 21 and 25. A capped run on the original ThreeTenBP fix passed the factory and reached Pattern.compile in Duration initialization. No ignored test covers this factory, and its emitted application harness is unchanged.

commits.summary: Check ASCII case-insensitive regex classes and alternatives
commits.body:
ThreeTenBP constructs a duration parser using optional groups, digits and punctuation under Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE. The native matcher now tests the opposite case of each ASCII letter against a bracket range when that flag is set, and applies negation afterward. This also handles alternatives and symbolic flag selection.

The changed suite passed 30 of 30 selections. Tests compare bracket ranges and alternatives to explicit character rules on both flag settings, with a JVM sweep over ASCII and boundary cases. A capped native check on the original ThreeTenBP clock fix reached ServiceLoader.load after Duration initialization. The affected pattern regressions run in the default tier.

commits.summary: Retry archived proof executions in a batch (verification pending)
commits.body:
The public proof command can follow a retry ID into a collected job and recheck its source claim, revisions and prepared byte binding. A batch accepts one ID per task while sharing preparations. Both handoff formats keep the prior executions discoverable. The regression test covers altered archive bytes, a different claim and an invalid batch.

Verification job 20261119-230939-retry-threetenbp-hours-after-exact-jdk-a retries the five ThreeTenBP obligations on their original artifacts, and separately replays the midnight witness on the parent clock, fixed clock and same-day claims. Its last step checks each structured refusal, predecessor binding and concrete replay. The changed tests passed 30 of 30 selections and example 310 validated.

commits.summary: Pin the clock retry to the integrated checker (verification pending)
commits.body:
The previous job reached the numeric factory and then the duration regex because its polling runner picked up a temporary file-set-aside commit while a scoped commit was finishing. All original executions survive. Job 20261119-231539-retry-threetenbp-hours-after-exact-jdk-a explicitly selects a78b7348, whose library contains both changes, for the same five strict attempts and three JVM reviews.

The probe record preserves the checker outputs for each diagnostic, including two separate JVM initializer observations and their assumptions. The released probe binary and both JARs were checked by hash. The local development probe binary digests were not captured at launch. No tests read these two added files.

commits.summary: Keep temporary jj file splits out of the verification queue
commits.body:
A runner polling another workspace picked up a ThreeTenBP job while sync.py was setting aside files outside a scoped commit. The transient tree carried only the first checker change. For a runnable job the queue now checks which commit last touched its file, including jobs with explicit source revisions, and waits while that commit is the temporary set-aside.

The queue regression exercises two simultaneous views of the same job, both revision choices and a commit message with an adjacent metadata line. On the actual recorded history the queue skips 0c74dbf6 and finds a78b7348. All 24 selected test files passed, including the 40 pipeline tests.

commits.summary: Integrate the clock retries and record all five native blockers
commits.body:
The pinned checker on a78b7348 passes Duration initialization on the original ThreeTenBP artifacts and stops at ServiceLoader.load in Chronology initialization for all five strict claims. Each task now has a rerunnable refusal packet in the gap inventory. The public JVM witness refutes the parent clock, satisfies the fixed clock and fails membership for the same-day domain.

The collector’s earlier job remains in history with its factory-only checker and regex refusals. The merged handoff links each execution once with its stage and qualifications. All 178 collected output digests matched. The independent checker of the eight public attempts, example 310 validation and all 28 selected test files passed.

commits.summary: Propose the restart watcher decision ID for trace review
commits.body: Two archived collector logs contain the same long-token finding. Masked context and an independent digest check identify the value as the ID of the watcher’s recorded continue decision. The allow-list entry remains proposed for a person to review. All 11 test selections for the proposal passed.

commits.summary: Check ThreeTenBP with a JVM-bound single-threaded chronology registry (verification pending)
commits.body:
Give the native checker a selected String-key ConcurrentHashMap, materialize empty registry objects observed on the pinned JVM, and check enum ordering with the selected JDK bytecode. The interpreter now distinguishes different enum declarations during replay. The public proof recipe binds the initializer class bytes and state separately for each revision and checks structured runtime assumptions. The five new tasks retain the original tick domains, cite their original tasks, and declare an unwind of 32. Tests cover aliasing, key equality, nulls and exceptions, model selection, and rejection of the wrong initializer or state. All 29 changed test groups and the example validator passed.

Verification pending for 20261120-000226-threetenbp-clock-fix-with-observed-chron, 20261120-000226-threetenbp-clock-parent-with-observed-ch, 20261120-000226-threetenbp-reversal-fix-with-observed-ch, 20261120-000227-threetenbp-reversal-parent-with-observed and 20261120-000227-threetenbp-same-day-with-observed-chrono. A capped native probe found a parent counterexample that the JVM reproduced. The original strict receipts remain linked to their original statements.

commits.summary: Queue each qualified ThreeTenBP obligation at its tested revision (verification pending)
commits.body: Five independent jobs pin the tested implementation at 0dc25164 and preserve each receipt separately. The word-level solver receives 600 seconds per obligation. Jobs 20261120-000226-threetenbp-clock-fix-with-observed-chron and 20261120-000226-threetenbp-clock-parent-with-observed-ch check elapsed whole hours. Jobs 20261120-000226-threetenbp-reversal-fix-with-observed-ch and 20261120-000227-threetenbp-reversal-parent-with-observed check sign reversal. Job 20261120-000227-threetenbp-same-day-with-observed-chrono compares the two revisions on same-day intervals. All five definitions passed submission validation.

commits.summary: Check every sub-hour crossing of midnight on both revisions (verification pending)
commits.body: The independent JVM driver enumerates the two-date grid and finds twelve signed sub-hour intervals that cross midnight. The production parent returns one hour in magnitude on all twelve and the fix returns zero. Two separately required public tasks freeze these inputs and the sampled chronology binding, with the same compiled subject and adapter as the full-grid tasks. A fixed-clock native probe established agreement with elapsed minutes on this subset. The example validator and all 24 selected test groups passed. Job 20261120-000646-prove-the-twelve-sub-hour-crossings-at-t checks both zero-hour claims and publishes their receipts.

commits.summary: Honor the per-claim checker deadline in public task batches (verification pending)
commits.body: The sub-hour verification job 20261120-000646-prove-the-twelve-sub-hour-crossings-at-t exited during argument parsing before launching either task. Parse the checker deadline once for single and batch execution and pass it to each batch member alongside its retry identity. The public-entry regression tests mixed outcomes, shared preparation and a 120-second budget on both calls. All 27 selected test groups passed. Superseding job 20261120-001338-prove-the-twelve-sub-hour-crossings-at-t runs the same command, budget, claims and expectations.
